dimensions.description: Claims are supported by calculations/citations; periods, filters, denominators, units, caveats and uncertainty are explicit. Assess visible support, not source-data correctness you cannot independently verify.
Answers the original request and requested scope, without replacing it with unrelated analyses.
Distinguishes observations from hypotheses and causal claims; explains how evidence supports conclusions.
When recommendations are requested, actions and priorities follow from evidence; otherwise, the requested analytical deliverable is directly usable.
A reader can understand the main findings, calculations and limitations without misleading wording or unnecessary detail. Images are not inspected by this text-only judge.
